marketing-display.purpose: Public root marketing only; operational UI retains its own scale.

marketing-headline.purpose: Explanatory marketing sections, never operational dashboards or checkout.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal elevation; marketing sections remain flat.

motion.name: control-fast
motion.purpose: Existing primary and secondary button color transitions.

motion.name: photo-open
motion.purpose: Supported desktop browsers only; visible photo clipping from 5% inset to none. Disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Marketing primary action
components.description: One dominant registration or task action.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 16px/1.25 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary { background:var(--zk-action, #000); color:var(--zk-action-fg, #fff); } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--zk-neutral-900, #171717); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Marketing secondary action
components.description: Secondary controls such as mobile navigation and dialog dismissal.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 16px/1.25 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary { background:var(--zk-surface, #fff); color:var(--zk-text, #000); border-color:var(--zk-border-strong, #d4d4d4); } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--zk-surface-muted, #fafafa); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product image placeholder
components.description: Honest text description while a genuine product capture is unavailable.
components.css: .ds-placeholder { margin:0; padding:32px; border-radius:20px; background:var(--zk-color-semantic-background-brand-subtle, #f7ffdf); color:var(--zk-text, #000); text-align:center; font-family:"League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-placeholder p { font-size:24px; font-weight:600; } .ds-placeholder span { font-size:14px; }

components.name: Public navigation link
components.description: Visible text navigation with an underline on hover and a distinct keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; font-family:"League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--zk-text, #000); padding:12px 0; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Inline explanatory link
components.description: A secondary text destination within explanatory content.
components.css: .ds-inline-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 0; font:600 16px/1.5 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; color:var(--zk-link, #000); text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-inline-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Zackisch adds optional browser-based QR ordering and payments to existing hospitality workflows. The restaurant keeps its POS and service choices; guests do not need an app/account.
keyCharacteristics: League Spartan across marketing and app.

rules.name: The Marketing Scope Rule
rules.body: Larger display typography belongs to the public website's explanatory hierarchy; keep the operational UI scale unchanged.

rules.name: The Visible Motion Rule
rules.body: Scroll enhancements begin from visible content.

dos: Use only real stock photographs from the internet with verified free rights for the intended commercial use.
Keep product image areas clearly text-labelled until actual screenshots are available.
donts: Never recolor or recreate the supplied logo artwork.
Never invent screenshots, endorsements or commercial claims.
